Title: ClearSpeech-ASR: A Compact Offline Speech Recognition Model

Abstract
We introduce ClearSpeech-ASR, a local automatic speech recognition model for
English audio transcription. The reference implementation is available at
https://github.com/example/clearspeech-asr and the model card is hosted at
https://huggingface.co/example/clearspeech-asr.

The model is evaluated on LibriSpeech and Common Voice using WER and CER.
The repository recommends Python 3.10 with uv and ffmpeg. The model can run on
CPU for small examples, while GPU is recommended for larger batches.

License: MIT.
